comment: Ratchet-only floors (apex-tools floor-ratchet). Domain floors are minimum percentages for the metrics the toolchain records; on stable cargo-llvm-cov, branch records are absent, so lines and functions carry the floor. The 2026-10-14 sweep measured every crate locally and pinned each domain at the floor of its measured minimum; values may only rise. orphanFloorPercent is pinned at 0 because the manifest measured zero orphans; mutationKillFloorPercent is pinned at 100 because the six-mutant sample kills six of six. Final phase: every domain floor = 100. SDK domains joined the table in the CI 100% sweep; android uses the kover line+branch minimum, node and unity use the lcov minimum, and 0 marks a lane whose coverage is not yet measured locally.

history.__note: phase-3 start: sample-based mutation smoke over apex-core kills 6/6 mutants; floor enforces a 60% minimum for the sampled set and ratchets upward with the sample
all-Rust conversion: domains pruned to the surviving Rust universe; apex-tools added

adversarial sweep: orphan ceiling pinned at the measured zero, mutation floor pinned at the six-of-six sample, and every crate floor pinned to the integer floor of its measured minimum of lines/functions

CI 100% sweep: SDK domains added. android floors are the kover line+branch minimum measured on the debug unit-test run; web and react-native are measured lcov minimums; unity, flutter and the apple lanes start at 0 until their lanes produce artifacts (unity re-measure pending, apple and flutter blocked on Xcode and flutter toolchains locally)
